scope: Read-only acquisition-script/report review plus size/MD5/SHA-256 comparison of four existing model files. No network request or model inference performed by reviewer.

local_model_identity.metadata_consistency: Both saved metadata responses name version 1.0 and URI equal to the corresponding MD5. Reproduced acquisition reports and QA_ACQUISITION.json match the same pins.

code_inspection.unknown_version_content_refusal: Server name/version/URI must match explicit pins; final body length, MD5 and SHA-256 are checked before writing. Existing target bytes are checked with a bounded read and are not silently replaced.
code_inspection.root_path_guard: CLI resolves destination and script path; rejects the entire nearest ancestor checkout containing .git. Without a checkout it rejects script.parents[2], the documented core/model_fetch distribution source root. Guards run before download calls.
code_inspection.https_and_redirects: HTTPS required; custom NoRedirect handler prevents following redirects. CDN URL requires an allowlisted host, exact pinned path, no credentials/query/fragment, and absent or 443 port.
code_inspection.bounded_reads: Metadata capped at 1 MiB; model download and existing-model validation bounded by pinned bytes plus one.
code_inspection.credentials_no_export: No application key, cookie, account token or unique device identifier is read or supplied by the script. Reports contain model hashes, version, public CDN URL and fixed SDK/device-type query only.
code_inspection.report_truthfulness: Reports explicitly keep device_cache_version_confirmed and standalone_inference_verified false; README distinguishes acquired bytes from phone cache identity, inference and HDR/style output.

findings_resolved: Original root guard covered only core/, allowing source-root siblings. Owner changed it to complete checkout/root guard; reviewed fix.
Initial URL validation did not prevent urllib redirects to another host/scheme. Owner added HTTPS requirement and NoRedirect handler; reviewed fix.

notes: Owner supplied successful live acquisition records; this review verifies saved bodies and reads hardened code without repeating network requests.
The owner completed a final live run of the hardened script. This reviewer separately checked the resulting local files and metadata, without making network requests.
Version 1.0 acquisition does not establish which version is cached on the phone; metadata matched_sdk_version is 0.0.0 for requested SDK 14.5.0.
Weight acquisition does not prove standalone inference, model tensor/operator interpretation, HDR semantics, or Natural blush/Purity2 equivalence.
The output-path guard is enforced by the documented command-line entry point. Direct Python callers of download() must independently choose an output directory outside the source checkout.
No model binaries are copied, redistributed or modified by this review.

post_review_owner_final_run.owner_report: Final hardened NoRedirect script downloaded both pinned models successfully over HTTPS.
